# Ai Ranko

> Ai Ranko is a free suite of AI-powered SEO and image tools for marketers, developers, content creators, and small businesses. Every tool is free, requires no signup, and follows Google's 2024 Search Quality Rater Guidelines (E-E-A-T) and Helpful Content System.

All tools run either fully in the browser (image tools, privacy-first) or via a backend powered by GPT-4o for AI analysis. Real data sources include Google Autocomplete, YouTube Autocomplete, Wikipedia OpenSearch, and live website crawling — never fake or mocked data.

## SEO AI Tools

- [SEO Strategy Maker](https://airanko.com/tools/seo-strategy-maker): Crawls your site and generates a complete AI-powered SEO strategy with keyword research, competitor analysis, content calendar, technical checklist, and a 6-month month-by-month roadmap.
- [Site Audit Tool](https://airanko.com/tools/site-audit): Real-crawl SEO audit. Fetches up to 15 pages of your site, runs 25+ checks across SEO, performance, accessibility, mobile, technical, and content categories. Returns per-issue fix instructions written by GPT-4o.
- [Bulk Meta & OG Checker](https://airanko.com/tools/meta-checker): Audit meta title, meta description, Open Graph, and Twitter Card tags for one URL or many at once.
- [Link Extractor](https://airanko.com/tools/link-extractor): Crawl any website and extract every link from all pages, including sitemap entries. Export to CSV or JSON.
- [Mobile Friendliness Checker](https://airanko.com/tools/mobile-checker): Preview any website in real mobile (iPhone SE/14/Pro Max, Galaxy S23, Pixel 7), tablet (iPad Mini/Pro), and desktop view.
- [HTML Sitemap Generator](https://airanko.com/tools/html-sitemap-generator): Generate a beautiful, customizable HTML sitemap from any URL. Reads sitemap.xml first or falls back to crawling. Includes 5 layouts (tree, cards, list, columns, compact), 4 themes (modern, minimal, classic, dark) with custom accent colors, live iframe preview, and 5 export formats (standalone HTML, HTML snippet, Markdown, JSON, plain text). Up to 100 pages per generation with configurable crawl depth.
- [Vibe Code Detector](https://airanko.com/tools/vibe-code-detector): Detect vibe-coded websites, GitHub repos, or pasted code built with AI tools like v0, Bolt, Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, Replit, Devin, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT or Claude. Three input modes plus 8 real measurement-based audits — inline code (incl. data-testid), CSS utility soup, HTML wrapper nesting, JS naming + AI-style comments, AI buzzword copywriting, security headers (URL mode), image quality, and generator-tag metadata. Every Vibe Score derives from real counts, not model probabilities. Full JSON export.
- [XML Sitemap Generator](https://airanko.com/tools/xml-sitemap-generator): Generate a valid sitemap.xml from any website. Reads existing sitemap.xml or sitemap index files first; falls back to real-crawl up to 500 pages at 1–4 depth levels. Full options: changefreq, priority (0.1–1.0), lastmod dates, image:image extensions, URL exclude patterns. Download as .xml or copy to clipboard.
- [Meta Pixel Checker](https://airanko.com/tools/meta-title-description-bulk-pixel-checker): Bulk-checks meta title and description pixel width against Google desktop and mobile SERP limits. Discovers and crawls sitemap.xml (via robots.txt, nested sitemap indexes, up to 300 URLs), or accepts a single URL or a pasted list. Real canvas-measured character counts and pixel widths, simulated Google SERP preview cards, CSV/JSON export, and one-click PDF report generation.
- [Meta Title & Description Generator](https://airanko.com/tools/meta-title-description-pixel-generator): AI-generates meta titles and descriptions in bulk, sized to fit Google Pixel width limits for desktop or mobile SERPs. Choose titles, descriptions, or both, pick how many variants per page, and fine-tune each one with live Google Pixel-width feedback before export.
- [Vibe Code Security Scanner](https://airanko.com/tools/vibe-code-security-scanner): Passive, read-only security scan for AI-built ("vibe-coded") websites. Checks for exposed API keys, missing security headers, leaked .env/.git files, vulnerable JS libraries, and verbose error pages that leak stack traces.

## AI Content Tools

- [AI Content Writer](https://airanko.com/tools/content-writer): Generate SEO articles tuned for Google's 2024 E-E-A-T signals, AI Overview hooks, FAQ schema, and a publish-ready checklist.
- [AI Content Optimizer](https://airanko.com/tools/content-optimizer): Audits existing content against Google's 2024 Search Quality Rater Guidelines and Helpful Content System. Returns 7 scores (E-E-A-T, Helpful Content, Keyword Optimization, Structure, Search Intent, On-Page SEO, Overall), 8-15 issues with fixes, heading rewrites, missing topics, missing LSI keywords, and AI-generated title + meta + slug + schema recommendation.
- [AI Content Detector & Grammar Checker](https://airanko.com/tools/plagiarism-checker): Detects AI-written text with AI% and Human% scores, fixes grammar errors with exact corrections, calculates readability (Flesch Reading Ease + grade level), and suggests 3 stronger alternatives for every weak word.

## Image AI Tools

- [Image Resizer & Converter](https://airanko.com/tools/image-resizer): Resize, crop, convert, and optimize images to WebP, PNG, JPEG. Runs fully in your browser.
- [Bulk Image Resizer](https://airanko.com/tools/bulk-image-resizer): Process unlimited images at once with global settings or per-image tweaks. 100% in-browser, files never leave your device.

## Utilities

- [Website Cloner](https://airanko.com/tools/website-cloner): Fetches a URL server-side, inlines CSS and JavaScript into one self-contained HTML file, rewrites asset URLs to absolute, shows a live iframe preview, and offers one-click download.

## Blog

- [Top 10 Free Photo Cropping Tools for Bloggers and Marketers (2026)](https://airanko.com/blog/top-10-free-photo-cropping-tools): Tested and ranked the most popular free image cropping tools on ease of use, aspect ratio presets, privacy, output quality, and extra features. Ai Ranko's Image Resizer ranks #2 for all-in-one, fully private image prep.
- [Top 10 Mobile-Friendly Websites in 2026 (Tested and Ranked)](https://airanko.com/blog/top-10-mobile-friendly-websites): An evidence-based ranking of the top 10 mobile-friendly websites in 2026. Tested on real iPhone 14, Galaxy S23, and Pixel 7 devices with Core Web Vitals scoring. Ai Ranko ranks #1, followed by Wikipedia, Stripe, Linear, Google Search, GitHub, Notion, Apple, Medium, and Smashing Magazine.

## About

- Homepage: https://airanko.com
- Blog: https://airanko.com/blog
- HTML Sitemap: https://airanko.com/sitemap
- XML Sitemap: https://airanko.com/sitemap.xml

## Key facts

- 18 free tools, no signup required, no watermark
- Privacy-first: image tools never upload files to a server
- AI tools powered by GPT-4o via OpenAI API
- Real data sources only — no fake or mocked metrics
- Built on Next.js 14 App Router, deployed on Vercel
- Follows Google Search Quality Rater Guidelines (2024) and Helpful Content System
- Each tool page includes JSON-LD structured data (SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList)
